notes: Advanced Agent Intelligence & Development Environment. Multi-Agent Orchestrator: decompose one goal into a dependency-ordered plan, assign tasks to Claude Code / DeepSeek Harness / Antigravity / Sidekick by capability, schedule independent tasks in parallel and dependent tasks sequentially, with file locking, conflict detection, result aggregation and an agent message bus. Language Server Protocol support: server registry, stdio transport, document sync and diagnostics store for Kotlin/Java/JS/TS/Python/Rust/Go/C/C++/JSON/YAML/HTML/CSS (optional, install on demand in PRoot). Advanced Workspace Management: multiple groups per project, READ/WRITE/EXECUTE/ADMIN grants, enforced read-only roles, path/symlink isolation, workspace locks and an audit log. Autonomous Testing & Repair: Gradle/Maven/npm/pnpm/yarn/pytest/Cargo/Go/CMake discovery, a bounded repair loop with regression checking and a history store. Sidekick hook engine (PreToolUse/PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure/PermissionRequest/Stop/SessionStart/SessionEnd/PreCompact/SubagentStart/SubagentStop with ALLOW/ASK/BLOCK/REWRITE/CONTINUE/STOP, most-restrictive-wins; CLI agents keep their native hooks). Reliability & Recovery engine: heartbeat, stall detection, exponential-backoff retry, task checkpoints and an idempotency guard. Multi-Agent Dashboard. This APK is SIGNED (V1+V2).
